ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Prevention Plan
ideas.description: Investigate Minnesota's new plan to prevent Medicaid fraud through unannounced visits to healthcare providers.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis to understand the effectiveness of the plan.
questions: What are the results so far?
ideas.insight: The new plan aims to prevent Medicaid fraud by conducting unannounced visits to healthcare providers. This story could investigate the effectiveness of the plan and its impact on healthcare providers.

ideas.title: Biological Labs Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the discovery of biological labs in Las Vegas and California and the FBI's involvement in the investigation.
ideas.angle: Public records and whistleblower information could provide insight into the labs' operations.
questions: What is the purpose of the labs?
What are the implications for public health and safety?
ideas.insight: The discovery of biological labs in unexpected locations raises concerns about public health and safety. This story could investigate the purpose and implications of these labs.
